method: Five fresh contexts per arm; identical five independent requests. Baseline uses current skills, candidate uses the revisions. Read all complete responses. No live services or mutations.
A1: One outcome-focused Feature issue tracks the capability; planning is a task or current phase, not a replacement Research deliverable.
A2: Preserves tenant access and CSV constraints, leaves unsettled decisions open, and does not implement or assume that planning commits the user to delivery.
A3: Specification approval alone does not satisfy capability completion; distinguishes the next decision or authorized delivery from current planning.
B1: Keeps the explicitly standalone Research scope and evidence/decision deliverable; does not manufacture a Feature parent or require implementation.
B2: Allows documented inconclusive findings and preserves draft-only scope.
C1: Detects that the agent-created planning title/type/checklist conflict with the user's broader tracked outcome; does not treat them as accepted scope narrowing.
C2: Does not move EX-101 to Done or publish a final capability-completion summary. Reports planning progress and remaining delivery or scope clarification.
C3: Does not start implementation, manufacture sub-issues, rewrite unrelated fields, cancel the issue, or claim actions occurred.
D1: Allows the accepted independent design sub-issue to complete without runtime work; proposes summary save/verification before status save/verification.
D2: Keeps the unfinished parent unchanged; accurately states design-only completion and preserves the original description.
E1: Changes only the title typo to Specify Scheduled exports; no relabeling, scope rewrite, reopening or automatic migration.
global: No actual service calls, unauthorized file edits or false claims of completed actions. Judge decisions, not exact wording or headings.
